verdict.rationale: A public API for driving an authentication product is a fair axis for this category, since some authenticator/MFA products expose programmatic interfaces. Nothing in the pack documents a public API for Microsoft Authenticator: the docs cover only in-app user interactions such as approving sign-ins, backup, and export, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
